messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: v2.11.0
parts:
Found it.

It's a bug in their includes. That should just be:
#include <stan/math/mix/mat.hpp>

instead of this:
#include <stan/math.hpp>
#include <stan/math/fwd/core.hpp>
#include <stan/math/fwd/scal/fun/value_of.hpp>
#include <stan/math/fwd/scal/fun/is_nan.hpp>
#include <stan/math/fwd/scal/fun/abs.hpp>
#include <stan/math/fwd/scal/fun/log.hpp>
#include <stan/math/fwd/mat/fun/multiply.hpp>
#include <stan/math/mix/mat/functor/hessian.hpp>


The traits are getting instantiated first with a limited set of instantiations before it gets used.



Daniel
